caption:
Stop copying the same order into three places. 🔁

When an order has to be typed into a chat, a stock sheet and a team message, each copy takes time and each one can go wrong.

A better flow starts with a map: where does the order arrive, where is it copied, who needs to know, and which cases need a person to decide. Automate the routine steps, and keep checkpoints for out-of-stock items, unclear addresses and unusual orders.

The example in the carousel is hypothetical.
